questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears in my notes and reports?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
What is your accent colour? It is the colour of the one key word in a stacked caption.
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines? The large line of a stacked caption is set in its bold weight.
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular or medium weight of the main font; left unset, the caption font or the bold is reused
Captions in the same main font, or a different one?
(found on their computer) the caption font; left unset, the regular weight of the main font is used
Do you want the key word in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your footage on an external drive? Which one?
Where does your B-roll footage live? Give me the folder, or several. (If you already indexed it with personal-broll-library I will start from that footage folder.)
Is there anything in your footage that must never be used as B-roll: people, places, private screens?

Your talking-head video is horizontal but the finished video is vertical. Should I crop it to fill the vertical frame, centred on you (fill), or show the whole horizontal picture with black above and below (fit)? Fill is the default for a talking head.
How big should the regular captions be, in pixels on the 1080 x 1920 frame? 54 reads well on a phone.
How big should the large line of a stacked caption be? 132 is the default; the engine shrinks it if the phrase would be wider than the frame.
What is the most of the video B-roll may cover, as a percentage? The speaker stays the main picture; about a third is the default.
How many stacked captions do you want? Stacks are for the idea, the number, the turn, the line to remember: two to four a minute at most is the default.
questions.default: 2 to 4 a minute at most, never back to back

questions.ask: Should I show you a quick draft and wait for your approval before rendering the full-quality final, or render the final straight away?
questions.default: show the draft and wait for approval before the final render
options: show the draft and wait for approval before the final render
render the final straight away and report
